description: Two sine oscillators, each with an even and an odd harmonic bank, a wavefolder and a distortion stage, and both mixed at a summed output

params.text: Sets that oscillator's pitch in semitones, four and a half octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Folds that oscillator's wave back on itself, with more folding clockwise
Drives that oscillator into a distortion stage, harder clockwise
Adds the even harmonics to that oscillator, each one quieter than the one below it
Adds the odd harmonics to that oscillator, each one quieter than the one below it
Attenuates and inverts the FM input for that oscillator
Attenuates and inverts the FMII input for that oscillator

inputs.text: Modulates that oscillator's pitch a volt to the octave, attenuated by its FM knob
Modulates that oscillator's frequency directly in hertz rather than by the octave, attenuated by its FMII knob
Scales the even harmonics of that oscillator, 10V leaving them at the knob setting and 0V removing them
Scales the odd harmonics of that oscillator, 10V leaving them at the knob setting and 0V removing them
Sets that oscillator's pitch, a volt to the octave, added to its COARSE knob
Adds folding to that oscillator, 0-6V on top of its CONTRAST knob
Adds distortion to that oscillator, -5V to 5V on top of its DIST knob

outputs.text: The A oscillator after its harmonics, folding and distortion, between -5V and 5V
The B oscillator after its harmonics, folding and distortion, between -5V and 5V

notes: the summed output carries as many channels as the two pitch inputs together, so with neither of them patched it is a two channel cable with the same mix on both channels
